gap: No result ChatGPT got states how much energy these stations actually delivered when a named lab drained them at the same light load. Notebookcheck (Marcus Schwarten, same method) got about 2,500 Wh from the Anker SOLIX F3000 at 200 W (81% of 3,072 Wh), about 2,650 Wh from the BLUETTI Elite 300 at just over 200 W (just under 88% of 3,014.4 Wh) and about 3,130 Wh from the BLUETTI Elite 400 at about 250 W (just under 82% of 3,840 Wh).
standout_why: StormWatts, the rival ChatGPT cited in both chats, says 'We have not tested these products hands-on.' It lists only rated Wh, with no usable-capacity figure, and uses an assumed 0.85 efficiency. Its only field test was one day on a Jackery Explorer 2000 Plus, which is not one of its 24 kits. ChatGPT's own answers also used an assumed '85% usable'. I could not open solargenadvisor.com or lightsonlabs.com (self-signed certificate error), so I can't say whether they include lab figures. I did not re-read our cited Dealectric pages. Backup Power Hub, which turned up in search, models usable energy as rated × 0.85 and does not measure it. A search summary credited it with a measured 2,065 Wh for the Elite 200 V2, but that figure is not on the page.
decides: This confirms the BLUETTI Elite 300 and Elite 400 kits as better value than the Anker SOLIX F3000 kit ChatGPT picked for home backup. On the same Notebookcheck low-load test, the F3000 delivered the least of the three, about 2,500 Wh. Measured energy per dollar: Elite 400 + 2×200 W at $1,804.05 link price ≈ $0.58 per delivered Wh; Elite 300 + 2×200 W at $1,614.05 ≈ $0.61; F3000 + 400 W at $2,299.99 with code (StormWatts' price, read 2026-11-08, not re-read by me) ≈ $0.92. It does not decide the ship-now pick. Both BLUETTI kits are pre-orders: Elite 300 + 2×200 W ships late November 2026, Elite 400 + 2×200 W mid-December 2026. The kits in range that ship now (ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 / SP039) have no named lab measurement I could source. So the page can name the BLUETTI kits as the measured-value option for shoppers who can wait, and has to present the ship-now pick on rated figures only.
